reviewerAccess: No login. Catalog and local library are accessible without hardware. Flashing requires a physical M-VAVE FM-1, USB Host/OTG, MIDI and stable power.

localOnly: in-memory app log and USB MIDI identity
externalServers: preview-image and firmware-author hosts referenced by the catalog
automaticallyRequestedOnline: catalog subject to daily source limit
dataInventory.deletion: Clear Android app data or uninstall. Individual package removal is available inside the app. There is no app account.
dataInventory.dataSafetyForm: Review third-party operators' actual collection and retention before final answers. Do not equate absence of publisher telemetry with absence of data received by external servers.

requiredManualChoices: foreground-service declaration and requested physical-device video
